name: Caramel Cold Brew Oat Milk Latte
caffeineNote: Label says single-shot coffee with no mg; the brand FAQ states 80 mg per 8 oz oat milk latte
summary: Single-shot cold brew on organic oat milk sweetened with dates, boosted with lion’s mane and reishi mushrooms. All 10 g of its sugar is naturally occurring, 0 g added — the honest version of the “no refined sugar” badge that Pop & Bottle’s matcha can wears over 12 g of added sugar. 2 g of protein per 8 oz can at 120 calories.
